description: The typed relationship graph across projects AND resources: who runs where, what depends on / deploys to / exposes what. Edges are frontmatter [[links]] keyed by relation (runs_on, depends_on, deploys_to, exposes, part_of, ...). Returns nodes, edges, and dangling links. Filter by project or type.

full.description: return everything, uncapped. By default long lists are trimmed (and, where the description says so, long texts cut) to fit an agent context, and what was left out is reported in `truncated`.

project.description: only edges touching this project/resource slug

type.description: only edges touching a node of this type

name: hub_graph
